lead.event: Bank Mandiri opened a Rp40 trillion credit facility for Jhonlin Group
lead.headline: BMRI opens Rp40 trillion credit facility for Jhonlin Group
lead.blurb: Bank Mandiri’s facility is disbursed to Jhonlin Baratama and secured by JARR and PGUN shares, with Rp17 trillion realized as of 26 October. The funds support Jhonlin Group’s coal industry development and related capital expenditure. RHB Sekuritas analyst Andrey Wijaya called the risk manageable because the disbursed amount is about 1% of Bank Mandiri’s estimated Rp1,700 trillion loan portfolio, while noting the group concentration warrants monitoring. Bank Mandiri says collateral coverage is 150%, based on the shares’ lowest intraday prices over the past month, and the agreement includes top-up mechanisms.
lead.copy_decision: kept: 1 new articles, no new fact

macro_flows.event: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below target
macro_flows.headline: Government bond auction raises Rp20.65 trillion, below Rp30 trillion target
macro_flows.blurb: At the 27 October auction, incoming bids fell 52.05% to Rp31.09 trillion from Rp64.86 trillion on 13 October. The government accepted higher yields, with FR0110 at 7.38%, FR0111 at 7.55% and FR0112 at 7.5%.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BBRI announces second share buyback phase of up to Rp1 trillion
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: BRI will run the phase from 22 October to 21 January 2027, following a first phase of up to Rp500 billion from 12 June to 11 September 2026. Shareholders approved buybacks of up to Rp3 trillion on 24 March 2025.

capital_raising_buybacks.event: BIPP approved a Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.headline: BIPP approves Rp100.57 billion private placement
capital_raising_buybacks.blurb: Bhuwanatala will issue 502.87 million shares at Rp200 each, to be taken up by affiliates Safire Capital and Gratamulia Pratama. The proceeds will support working capital, business development and expansion without changing control. Issuance is scheduled for 4 November, with listing on 5 November.

earnings_guidance.event: BCA reports Q3 2026 results and raises 2026 loan growth outlook
earnings_guidance.headline: BBCA raises 2026 loan growth outlook to 10-12% after Q3 results
earnings_guidance.blurb: BCA shares rose 4.08% to Rp5,100 in the first trading session on 28 October. Loans grew 12.6% year on year to Rp1,063 trillion in September, while nine-month consolidated net profit rose 4.2% to Rp45.2 trillion. The projection exceeds the original 8-10% Business Plan target, which the bank has not formally revised.
earnings_guidance.copy_decision: rewritten: 3 new articles with a new fact: BCA shares rose 4.08% to Rp5,100 in the first trading session on 28 October 2026.

earnings_guidance.event: Maha Properti reports third-quarter loss and widening cumulative deficit
earnings_guidance.headline: MPRO reports Rp33.08 billion loss as cumulative deficit widens to Rp245.02 billion
earnings_guidance.blurb: Maha Properti's revenue rose 44.62% to Rp3.63 billion, while cost of goods sold and direct expenses increased to Rp2.53 billion. Its loss narrowed from Rp54.89 billion in the same period last year.

earnings_guidance.headline: ANTM reports nine-month 2026 profit growth as sales rise 22.8%
earnings_guidance.blurb: Aneka Tambang’s January-September net sales rose to Rp88.48 trillion, with domestic sales accounting for Rp83.86 trillion, about 95% of the total. Gold generated Rp68.41 trillion, or 77% of sales.

earnings_guidance.event: Permata Bank reports Q3 loan growth and nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.headline: BNLI reports 10.1% Q3 loan growth and Rp2.6 trillion nine-month profit
earnings_guidance.blurb: Permata Bank’s conventional lending rose 13.9% to Rp153.4 trillion, while assets increased 2.9% to Rp277.2 trillion. CASA made up 56.4% of third-party funds, and the loan-to-deposit ratio was 92.1%, up from 80.9% a year earlier.
